families.accept: Full export preserves all eight returned rows in native structural order. Unread export contains paths [0],[0,1],[1], with only [0] labeled ancestor context; all-source counts remain visible and are not relabeled as selected counts. Conflicting original parent_id does not reparent a row.

Deleted body/author stay unavailable even if raw fields contain text and an attributable user. Missing body, empty text and media-only cleaned text are not invented. Duplicate entry IDs have unknown read state, duplicate participant IDs do not identify an author, numeric/string IDs stay distinct. Unmatched unread999 and all native warnings survive.

The local JSON download decodes to the complete normalized API report without projection loss, retains null/false/zero/empty/Unicode/sourceHTML/order/metadata, and its actual SHA256/byte count match the displayed and CLI receipts. Native report and authored inputs stay unchanged.

Open actual exported HTML in a fresh offline browser; topic/entry/participant HTML is inert escaped text, no scripts/forms/iframes/remote assets, no automatic request, no storage write, no executable sourceURL. Only internal navigation and explicit local JSON download are active. Check actual desktop/narrow/print DOM with long title, word and deep-context paths.

Actual installed-package CLI invokes the unchanged report reader once, producing exactly the raw reader's topic/view GETs on synthetic loopback fixtures in either mode. No POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/mark-read or attachment request. Captured timestamp is report creation, source cached/eventually-consistent/no freshness guarantee is visible.

Existing regular file, directory and symlink targets survive byte/identity unchanged and return nonzero without success stdout. Missing parents and output failure follow the existing native writer contract. HTTP/read/malformed/unavailable-unread/render/size refusal leaves no new successful artifact. Bound exact JSON/HTML thresholds and complete refusal above them without truncation.

Explicit empty unread list yields an honest empty selection with observed counts/cache limits; missing unread list refuses focused export; duplicated unread ID refuses ambiguity. Full reports preserve unknown markers. No disagreement is silently reinterpreted as a complete fresh empty discussion.

Source composition changes only claimed paths/additive CLI/README spans. Existing report/API/transport/MCP/readers/writers/dependencies and peer enrollment/group/other export commands remain exact. Tests use authored data, no school/session/provider operation.

limits: No claim of raw HTTP response byte preservation: embedded JSON is the complete normalized report.
No independent live Canvas access or server-cache freshness is inferred.
Late filesystem failure follows unchanged writer cleanup semantics; no stronger crash-durability promise is added.
